blocks.text: “Pinoy Big Brother” housemate Mikee Quintos and recently evicted housemate Cianne Dominguez apologized for gestures that appeared to mock persons with disabilities (PWDs). Quintos and Dominguez’s actions were earlier called out by viewers and the National Council on Disability Affairs (NCDA), which pointed out a clip of them “imitating speech characteristics associated with persons with disabilities.” “I get why it would be sensitive. Di ko po naisip na it would be — sorry, Kuya,” Quintos said in an episode of the reality show on Monday, Nov. 23.
